prompt: We tested the badges idea with a 'coming soon' button and only 2% clicked. So badges are dead, right?
expectations: Does not agree that badges are dead
Checks whether the test was fair: the plain button stripped out everything attractive about badges, was in the wrong place/moment (bottom of settings), and no threshold was set
Says 2% cannot be judged as a pass or fail because no threshold was set beforehand
Proposes a fairer test that keeps the appeal (e.g. a mockup of a real badge shown at the moment it would be earned) with a threshold set before running it
Asks the user to guess the number before setting the threshold
Does not recommend building badges now
